evidence.reason: `schema_problem` is intended to return the first schema violation instead of raising, but its type check unconditionally indexes `_SCHEMA_TYPES[t]`. `_SCHEMA_TYPES` has no `"number"` entry, so a deployment local-review schema using JSON Schema type `"number"` on a present property raises `KeyError` rather than returning an unsupported-schema diagnostic, losing the receipt verdict and tick result. This is an implementation defect in the intended fail-closed schema evaluation, not a new protection requirement.
